headline: Wedding & editorial photographer
tagline: Honest photographs for people who'd rather feel a moment than pose for it.
aboutText:
I'm Elena, a photographer based on Siargao island.

Nine years ago I traded a desk in Manila for a boat schedule and a camera bag. Since then I've shot over a hundred weddings, three resort rebrands, and a growing shelf of magazine work — always chasing the same thing: pictures that look like the day actually felt.

I shoot quietly, direct gently, and deliver fast.
servicesIntro: Collections are fixed and travel-ready — no surprise fees.

services.title: Weddings & engagements
services.description: Full-day coverage, two photographers, sneak peeks in 48 hours, and a hand-edited gallery.

services.title: Editorial & brand shoots
services.description: Resorts, restaurants, and makers — imagery built for menus, websites, and press kits.

services.title: Prints & albums
services.description: Layflat albums and fine-art prints, color-graded to match the gallery you fell in love with.

work.description: A barefoot wedding on the boardwalk — twelve guests, one perfect swell, zero umbrellas.
Three days of shooting across villas, kitchen, and lagoon for the reopening website and print collateral.
A ten-page feature on Surigao home kitchens, shot entirely on 35mm film.

credentials.title: Best in Show, Philippine Photo Awards

testimonials.text: We forgot she was there — then cried at the gallery. Every picture felt like the day itself.
testimonials.author: Andrea & Josh

testimonials.text: The resort has never looked this honest. Bookings went up the month the new photos went live.
testimonials.author: Menchie dela Cruz

faq.question: Do you travel for weddings?
faq.answer: Happily. Boat and fare are quoted upfront; anywhere in the Philippines, and passports for the right story.

faq.question: How fast is delivery?
faq.answer: 48-hour sneak peeks, full gallery in four weeks, albums eight weeks after design approval.
